mapper.select: SELECT tml.id, tml. CODE, tml.location_out_id, tl.`name` AS 'location_out_name', tml.location_in_id, tl2.`name` AS 'location_in_name', tml.tray_id, tml.create_time, tt.`code` AS 'zaiju_code', tml.wcs_id, ttw.task_type, ttw.task_status, ttw.tray_code FROM t_move_library tml LEFT JOIN t_tray tt ON tml.tray_id = tt.id LEFT JOIN t_location tl ON tml.location_out_id = tl.id LEFT JOIN t_location tl2 ON tml.location_in_id = tl2.id LEFT JOIN t_task_wcs ttw ON tml.wcs_id = ttw.id WHERE tml.del_flag = 0 AND tt.code = #{tml.zaijuCode} AND tml.code = #{tml.code} ORDER BY id DESC

SELECT * FROM t_location WHERE location_plies = ( SELECT location_plies FROM t_location WHERE id = #{tld.id} ) AND reservoir_id = 33 AND goods_allocation_status = 1 AND (pallet_num = "" OR pallet_num IS NULL)

SELECT tmld.id, tmld.move_library_code, tmld.stock_id, tmld.material_id, tmld.count, tmld.batch_code, tm.`code` AS 'material_code', tm.`name` AS 'material_name', ts.material_id AS 'ts_material_id', ts.batch_code AS 'ts_batch_code', ts.count AS 'ts_count' FROM t_move_library_detail tmld LEFT JOIN t_material tm ON tmld.material_id = tm.id LEFT JOIN t_stock ts ON tmld.stock_id = ts.id WHERE tmld.del_flag = 0 AND tmld.move_library_code = #{smld.code}
SELECT * FROM t_stock WHERE tray_id = #{sts.trayId} AND del_flag = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_task_wcs ttw LEFT JOIN t_tray tt ON ttw.tray_id = tt.id WHERE ttw.task_status != 3 AND tt.tray_category = 1 AND ttw.del_flag = 0

SELECT * FROM t_location WHERE extention_frist_id = ( SELECT extention_frist_id FROM t_location WHERE id = #{twv.locationId} ) AND location_plies = ( SELECT location_plies FROM t_location WHERE id = #{twv.locationId} ) AND extention_type = 2
SELECT main_task_no FROM t_task_wcs WHERE location_id = #{tl.id} AND task_type = 2 AND ( task_status = 1 OR task_status = 2 )
SELECT * FROM t_task_wcs WHERE main_task_no = #{ttwv.mainTaskNo} AND task_type = 5
